New to Precious Metals
Start here. Four topics walk you through why people buy physical gold and silver, how much to allocate, which metals to pick, and when to enter the market.
If you’ve never bought physical precious metals before, the choices look overwhelming: which metal, what form, how much, where to store it, when to enter the market. This four-topic path strips it down to the questions you actually need to answer in roughly the order they matter.
Most readers finish all four topics in about 25 minutes. None of them assume any prior background.
📊
What you'll be able to do after this path
Explain in plain English why physical bullion plays a different role than stocks or ETFs
Pick a starting allocation that fits your existing financial picture
Choose between gold and silver (and know when platinum or palladium matter)
Avoid the three timing mistakes that cost first-time buyers the most
What’s in this path
Why Buy Physical Gold?
Three parts: the historical role of gold as money, how it behaves during economic stress, and where it sits in a modern portfolio.
How Much Gold and Silver to Buy
A practical framework for sizing your precious metals allocation based on time horizon, financial foundation, and risk tolerance.
Which Precious Metals to Buy
A practical guide to choosing among gold, silver, platinum, and palladium, with allocation strategies and form options for new investors.
When to Buy Gold & Silver
How to think about timing gold and silver purchases, why dollar-cost averaging beats market timing, and the indicators worth watching.
